title: Playboy Magazine November 1985 The Women Of Mensa With Centerfold Vintage
descriptionText: The Playboy Magazine November 1985 issue features an article titled "The Women Of Mensa" with a centerfold included. As a collectible vintage piece, this magazine provides a glimpse into the history and culture of the time, showcasing the perspectives and interests of its readers. With its iconic Playboy branding and informative content, this publication offers a unique window into the world of the 1980s for enthusiasts of vintage magazines and history buffs alike.
